[နာမ+ရူပ+နာမရူပ။ ဒွန်အရာ၌ သုတိတူ တစ်ခုကြွင်းပြု။ နီတိ၊သုတ္တ။၇၃၇။နာမချင်း，ရူပချင်း တစ်ခုကြွင်းပြု။ မူလဋီ၊၂။၁၁၆။ မာတရော ပိတရော နာမချင်း，ရူပချင်း တခုကြွင်းပြု။ မူလဋီ၊၂။၁၁၆။ မာတရော ပိတရော နာမ၊ ရူပံတျာဒီသုပုဗ္ဗကံ။ ပဒံ ပရမ္ပိ ဝါ ဧက-ဒေသော ဝါပျဝသိဿတေ။ ဘေဒစိန္တာ။ ၂၈၂။]

— °- gotta , n. , the personal name and clan name ; Vin I 36, 6 (appekacce bhagavato santike ~aṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu); II 239, 16 (yā kāci mahānadiyo … tā mahāsamuddaṃ pattā jahanti purimāni ~āni mahāsamuddo tv eva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti); S I 43, 12* (rūpaṃ jīrati maccānaṃ ~aṃ na jīrati); Ja VI 78, 6* ; Ap 22, 25 (mātuyā ~ena paññāyissati … naro); Kv 179, 29 (arahā itthipurisānaṃ ~aṃ na jāneyya); Pj I 113, 28 (sā hi ~ato apākaṭā); — °- dheyya , m.n. , a name; naming ; Abh 114 (~âdhivacanaṃ); M I 337, 6 (tassa … mahānirayassa tayo ~ā honti); Vv 84:45 (kiṃ ~aṃ kiṃ pana tassa gottaṃ); Ja III 305, 17* ; Nidd I 388, 16 (purāṇaṃ mātāpitikaṃ ~aṃ); Ap 485, 4 (Rādho ti ~ena hessati satthu sāvako); Ap-a 422, 2 (tassa rukkhassa ~o); Sadd 392, 11 (~aṃ); — °- pada , n. , 1. a noun ; Sv 26, 13 (me ti ādīni ~āni); Th-a I 4, 30 (suṇāthā ti akkhyātapadaṃ itarāni ~āni); — 2. the word ‘nāma’; Vibh-a 169, 8 ; — °- saññā , f. , a word of special (non-etymological) meaning ; Sp 208, 5 (ekarattātikkantassa vā ~ā esā yadidaṃ ābhidosiko ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nāmaṃ saññā) = Ps III 295, 16 ; Sp 833, 17 (~āsu pana vuccamānāsu taṃ taṃ nāmaṃ ajānantānaṃ sammoho yeva hoti); Sadd 379, 14 ; — °- siddhika , mfn. , attaching importance or luck to a name ; Ja I 402, 10 (asuko kira bhikkhu ~o maṅgalaṃ nāmaṃ āharāpetī ti); — °- hetuka , mfn. , having name as its cause ; Vibh 139, 22 (chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ ~aṃ); 139, 31 (nāmapaccayā phasso ~o); — see also anāmikā, isināmaka ( sv isi ), ekanāmaka ( sv eka ), evaṃnāmaka, evaṃnāmika ( sv evaṃ ), kiṃnāmaka, catunāmaka ( sv catu[r] ), taṃnāmaka ( sv ta[d] ), nānānāmika.
